Re Activities of S.F.C. 459 Mal Singh.

S.F.C. 459 Mal Singh, age about 40 years attached to the
Kingpo Police Station is a member of the local Indian
Independence League and is also a volunteer of the Indian
National Army and at present receiving part time training in the
military training in the Indian National Army Training Camp
at 330 Paoshing Road.

Inspite of his loyalty and sincerity to the I.I.L. and
the Indian National Army, his general attitude is quite
against those who do not donate for the Indian National Army.
He often speaks in the meeting without having permission from
the chairman or the other authorised person. In the public
meeting, he always criticized the members of the League for
being pro-British or accusing them to be idle and for adopting
the double faced policy.

On more than one occasions he criticized chairman Ram
Chand for taking some pro-British people in the League. In
particular his allegation is against B.Bobby who misappropriated
$9,000.00 and 12 bags of wheat which was bought for the
Indian National Army training camp 330 Paoshing Road. For
this, he was suspended of duty but the chairman reinstated him
to his former position as Liaison officer. The public is angry
over the decision of the chairman. He is not anti League but
he is anti some of the League members who are still taking
relief from the Swiss Consulate and still keeping their double
face policy.

Officer i/c Foreign Affairs.

外事科
5-78
1944年9月19日
1955年9月19日
事由：印度自由联盟成员 S.F.C. 459 马尔·辛格（Mal Singh）的活动情况。

S.F.C. 459 马尔·辛格，年龄约40岁，隶属于虹口巡捕房，系当地印度自由联盟（Indian Independence League）成员，亦为印度国民军（Indian National Army）志愿人员，目前正于宝兴路330号印度国民军训练营接受兼职军事训练。

尽管他对印度自由联盟及印度国民军表现出忠诚与诚意，但其总体态度对那些未向印度国民军捐款者甚为不满。他经常在会议上未经主席或其他授权人员许可便擅自发言。在公开集会上，他总是批评联盟成员亲英，或指责他们懒散并奉行两面派政策。

他曾不止一次批评主席拉姆·钱德（Ram Chand）将一些亲英人士吸纳进联盟。他特别指控 B.鲍比（B.Bobby）侵吞了为宝兴路330号印度国民军训练营购买的9,000.00美元及12袋小麦。为此，他被停职，但主席又恢复了他原先担任的联络官职务。公众对主席的决定感到愤怒。他并非反对联盟本身，而是反对联盟中某些仍在瑞士领事馆领取救济金并继续奉行两面派政策的成员。

外事科主管警官
